lines.text: After Nebuchadnezzar carried Jeconiah off to Babylon, the LORD showed Jeremiah two baskets of figs in front of the temple.
One basket held very good figs and the other held very bad figs that could not be eaten.
The LORD called Judah's exiles good figs, sent them to Egypt, and promised to bring them back.
The LORD said He would deal with King Jehoiakim, his officials, and Jerusalem's remnant like the bad figs.
The LORD would send sword, famine, plague until they perished from the land given to them and their fathers.
